answer: Give every new identity a beacon ticket: a public randomness beacon publishes a fresh saffron ticket each hour, and an agent must solve a cipher puzzle keyed to that ticket — about 90 seconds of compute — before it can transact. A verifier checks the ticket and puzzle in milliseconds. One fake costs 90 seconds; a tide of 10,000 fakes costs over 10 days of CPU, while an honest agent pays once and reuses its ticket all hour.
